{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "Bradford assay",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tiprack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    tiprack_300 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 5)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat", 2)
    tube_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    
    # Load pipettes
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack_20])
    p300_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p300_multi_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tiprack_300])
    
    # Define liquids
    bradford = protocol.define_liquid(name="bradford", description="Bradford reagent", display_color="#FF0000")
    standards = {}
    for i in range(1, 9):
        standards[f"standard {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"standard {i}", description=f"BSA standard {i}", display_color="#00FF00")
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 21):
        samples[f"sample {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}", display_color="#0000FF")
    
    # Load standards into column 6 of the plate (wells A6-H6)
    for i in range(1, 9):
        well = plate[f"{chr(65+i)}6"]
        well.load_liquid(liquid=standards[f"standard {i}"], volume=10)
    
    # Load samples into tube rack wells
    sample_well_names = [
        "A1","A2","A3","A4","A5","A6",
        "B1","B2","B3","B4","B5","B6",
        "C1","C2","C3","C4","C5","C6",
        "D1","D2"
    ]
    for idx, well_name in enumerate(sample_well_names):
        well = tube_rack[well_name]
        well.load_liquid(liquid=samples[f"sample {idx+1}"], volume=1000)
    
    # Load Bradford reagent into reservoir well A1
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=bradford, volume=15000)
    
    # Destination wells for the 20 samples (duplicate in columns 1-5)
    dest_wells = []
    for col in range(5):
        for row_idx in range(8):
            row_letter = chr(65 + row_idx)
            dest_wells.append(plate[f"{row_letter}{col+1}"])
    
    # Transfer each sample (5 µL) in duplicate to two destination wells
    for sample_idx in range(20):
        # Get source well name from the predefined list
        src_well_name = sample_well_names[sample_idx]
        src_well = tube_rack[src_well_name]
        
        dest1 = dest_wells[2*sample_idx]
        dest2 = dest_wells[2*sample_idx+1]
        
        # First replicate
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, src_well)
        p20.dispense(5, dest1)
        p20.drop_tip()
        
        # Second replicate
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, src_well)
        p20.dispense(5, dest2)
        p20.drop_tip()
    
    # Add 250 µL Bradford reagent to all used wells (48 wells total)
    standard_wells = [plate[f"{chr(65+row)}6"] for row in range(8)]
    all_dest_wells = dest_wells + standard_wells
    
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(250, reservoir["A1"])
    for well in all_dest_wells:
        p300_multi.dispense(250, well)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()"}

tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "Bradford assay",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tiprack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    tiprack_300 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 5)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat", 2)
    tube_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    
    # Load pipettes
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack_20])
    p300_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p300_multi_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tiprack_300])
    
    # Define liquids
    bradford = protocol.define_liquid(name="bradford", description="Bradford reagent", display_color="#FF0000")
    standards = {}
    for i in range(1, 9):
        standards[f"standard {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"standard {i}", description=f"BSA standard {i}", display_color="#00FF00")
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 21):
        samples[f"sample {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}", display_color="#0000FF")
    
    # Load standards into column 6 of the plate (wells A6-H6)
    for row_idx in range(8):
        well = plate[f"{chr(65+row_idx)}6"]
        well.load_liquid(liquid=standards[f"standard {row_idx+1}"], volume=10)
    
    # Load samples into tube rack wells
    sample_well_names = [
        "A1","A2","A3","A4","A5","A6",
        "B1","B2","B3","B4","B5","B6",
        "C1","C2","C3","C4","C5","C6",
        "D1","D2"
    ]
    for idx, well_name in enumerate(sample_well_names):
        well = tube_rack[well_name]
        well.load_liquid(liquid=samples[f"sample {idx+1}"], volume=1000)
    
    # Load Bradford reagent into reservoir well A1
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=bradford, volume=15000)
    
    # Destination wells for the 20 samples (duplicate in columns 1-5)
    dest_wells = []
    for col in range(5):
        for row_idx in range(8):
            row_letter = chr(65 + row_idx)
            dest_wells.append(plate[f"{row_letter}{col+1}"])
    
    # Transfer each sample (5 µL) in duplicate to two destination wells
    for sample_idx in range(20):
        # Get source well name from the predefined list
        src_well_name = sample_well_names[sample_idx]
        src_well = tube_rack[src_well_name]
        
        dest1 = dest_wells[2*sample_idx]
        dest2 = dest_wells[2*sample_idx+1]
        
        # First replicate
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, src_well)
        p20.dispense(5, dest1)
        p20.drop_tip()
        
        # Second replicate
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, src_well)
        p20.dispense(5, dest2)
        p20.drop_tip()
    
    # Add 250 µL Bradford reagent to all used wells (48 wells total)
    standard_wells = [plate[f"{chr(65+row)}6"] for row in range(8)]
    all_dest_wells = dest_wells + standard_wells
    
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(250, reservoir["A1"])
    for well in all_dest_wells:
        p300_multi.dispense(250, well)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()"}

```
from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "Bradford assay",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tiprack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    tiprack_300 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 5)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat", 2)
    tube_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    
    # Load pipettes
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack_20])
    p300_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p300_multi_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tiprack_300])
    
    # Define liquids
    bradford = protocol.define_liquid(name="bradford", description="Bradford reagent", display_color="#FF0000")
    standards = {}
    for i in range(1, 9):
        standards[f"standard {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"standard {i}", description=f"BSA standard {i}", display_color="#00FF00")
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 21):
        samples[f"sample {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}", display_color="#0000FF")
    
    # Load standards into column 6 of the plate (wells A6-H6)
    for row_idx in range(8):
        well = plate[f"{chr(65+row_idx)}6"]
        well.load_liquid(liquid=standards[f"standard {row_idx+1}"], volume=10)
    
    # Load samples into tube rack wells
    sample_well_names = [
        "A1","A2","A3","A4","A5","A6",
        "B1","B2","B3","B4","B5","B6",
        "C1","C2","C3","C4","C5","C6",
        "D1","D2"
    ]
    for idx, well_name in enumerate(sample_well_names):
        well = tube_rack[well_name]
        well.load_liquid(liquid=samples[f"sample {idx+1}"], volume=1000)
    
    # Load Bradford reagent into reservoir well A1
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=bradford, volume=15000)
    
    # Destination wells for the 20 samples (duplicate in columns 1-5)
    dest_wells = []
    for col in range(5):
        for row_idx in range(8):
            row_letter = chr(65 + row_idx)
            dest_wells.append(plate[f"{row_letter}{col+1}"])
    
    # Transfer each sample (5 µL) in duplicate to two destination wells
    for sample_idx in range(20):
        src_well_name = sample_well_names[sample_idx]
        src_well = tube_rack[src_well_name]
        dest1 = dest_wells[2*sample_idx]
        dest2 = dest_wells[2*sample_idx+1]
        # First replicate
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, src_well)
        p20.dispense(5, dest1)
        p20.drop_tip()
        # Second replicate
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, src_well)
        p20.dispense(5, dest2)
        p20.drop_tip()
    
    # Add 250 µL Bradford reagent to each used well (48 wells total)
    standard_wells = [plate[f"{chr(65+row)}6"] for row in range(8)]
    all_dest_wells = dest_wells + standard_wells
    
    for well in all_dest_wells:
        p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
        p300_multi.aspirate(250, reservoir["A1"])
        p300_multi.dispense(250, well)
        p300_multi.drop_tip()
```

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "Bradford assay",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tiprack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    tiprack_300 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 5)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat", 2)
    tube_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    
    # Load pipettes
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack_20])
    p300_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p300_multi_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tiprack_300])
    
    # Define liquids
    bradford = protocol.define_liquid(name="bradford", description="Bradford reagent", display_color="#FF0000")
    standards = {}
    for i in range(1, 9):
        standards[f"standard {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"standard {i}", description=f"BSA standard {i}", display_color="#00FF00")
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 21):
        samples[f"sample {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}", display_color="#0000FF")
    
    # Load standards into column 6 of the plate (wells A6-H6)
    for row_idx in range(8):
        well = plate[f"{chr(65+row_idx)}6"]
        well.load_liquid(liquid=standards[f"standard {row_idx+1}"], volume=10)
    
    # Load samples into tube rack wells
    sample_well_names = [
        "A1","A2","A3","A4","A5","A6",
        "B1","B2","B3","B4","B5","B6",
        "C1","C2","C3","C4","C5","C6",
        "D1","D2"
    ]
    for idx, well_name in enumerate(sample_well_names):
        well = tube_rack[well_name]
        well.load_liquid(liquid=samples[f"sample {idx+1}"], volume=1000)
    
    # Load Bradford reagent into reservoir well A1
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=bradford, volume=15000)
    
    # Destination wells for the 20 samples (duplicate in columns 1-5)
    dest_wells = []
    for col in range(5):
        for row_idx in range(8):
            row_letter = chr(65 + row_idx)
            dest_wells.append(plate[f"{row_letter}{col+1}"])
    
    # Transfer each sample (5 µL) in duplicate to two destination wells
    for sample_idx in range(20):
        src_well_name = sample_well_names[sample_idx]
        src_well = tube_rack[src_well_name]
        dest1 = dest_wells[2*sample_idx]
        dest2 = dest_wells[2*sample_idx+1]
        
        # First replicate
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, src_well)
        p20.dispense(5, dest1)
        p20.drop_tip()
        
        # Second replicate
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, src_well)
        p20.dispense(5, dest2)
        p20.drop_tip()
    
    # Add 250 µL Bradford reagent to each used well (48 wells total)
    standard_wells = [plate[f"{chr(65+row)}6"] for row in range(8)]
    all_dest_wells = dest_wells + standard_wells
    
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    for well in all_dest_wells:
        p300_multi.aspirate(250, reservoir["A1"])
        p300_multi.dispense(250, well)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()"}

protocol.py: 3 biology problems (2 errors, 1 note).

1. ERROR CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: bradford (well A1 in slot 4)
   line 80:  p300_multi.aspirate(250, reservoir["A1"])
   At line 80 the tip went into bradford (well A1 in slot 4) while it still carried sample 1
   (tube A1 in slot 3), sample 2 (tube A2 in slot 3), sample 3 (tube A3 in slot 3) and
   sample 4 (tube A4 in slot 3) from an earlier step. A tip that has touched one liquid
   leaves a little of it in the next liquid it touches, so this stock now holds material
   that does not belong there. Liquid drawn from it then took the unwanted material along
   into 7 other wells: wells B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1 and H1 in slot 2.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 4.
   Also reached 7 other wells: wells B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1 and H1 in slot 2.
   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 80 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand
   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.
   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
           https://www.labmanager.com/minimizing-cross-contamination-in-automated-liquid-handling-workflows-35194
   Source: WHO: dos and don'ts for molecular testing
           https://www.who.int/teams/global-malaria-programme/case-management/diagnosis/nucleic-acid-amplification-based-diagnostics/dos-and-don-ts-for-molecular-testing
   [ef8a01be708c]

2. ERROR WELL-CAPACITY: More liquid than the well can hold: 3255 ul in a 366 ul well, 7
wells
   line 81:  p300_multi.dispense(250, well)
   At line 81 the robot filled wells B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1 and H1 in slot 2 past the rim
   (366 ul to the rim by the labware definition's shape; the maker states 360 ul) (this line
   did it 7 times), reaching 3255 ul. The liquid runs into the neighbouring wells and onto
   the deck; the volumes still add up on paper, so the plate map does not see it, and the
   simulator says nothing. Wells: wells B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1 and H1 in slot 2.
   Affected: wells B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1 and H1 in slot 2.
   Fix: Use labware with bigger wells, or scale every volume down so the fullest well stays
   under the stated maximum with room to mix.
   Source: Opentrons labware schema 2: totalLiquidVolume, the total well volume in
   microlitres
           https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Opentrons/opentrons/edge/shared-data/labware/schemas/2.json
   Source: Bartley et al. 2023, LabOP: a protocol never adds more liquid than its container
   holds
           https://jakebeal.github.io/Publications/JETC23-LabOP.pdf
   [b3fe53d0e48a]

3. NOTE NO-SAMPLE-INTO-REAGENT-WELL: (proposed) A tip that had been in a sample went into a
reagent
   line 80:  p300_multi.aspirate(250, reservoir["A1"])
   At line 80 the tip touched the liquid in well A1 in slot 4 while it still carried sample
   1 (tube A1 in slot 3), sample 2 (tube A2 in slot 3), sample 3 (tube A3 in slot 3) and
   sample 4 (tube A4 in slot 3) from an earlier step. A tip that has touched one liquid
   leaves a little of it in the next liquid it touches, and the protocol never transfers
   that liquid into this well on purpose. A reagent is shared: the master mix, the enzyme or
   the primer in that well goes into every reaction on the plate. A tip that has been in one
   sample leaves a little of it in the next liquid it touches, so a sample carried into a
   reagent well turns up in every well that reagent reaches, and a no-template control can
   no longer be trusted. Liquid was later taken out of the affected wells, and the unwanted
   material went along into 7 other wells: wells B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1 and H1 in slot 2.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 4.
   Also reached 7 other wells: wells B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1 and H1 in slot 2.
   Fix: Use a fresh tip for each sample at line 80, or add the reagent to the wells first,
   while the tip is clean, and the samples afterwards with a fresh tip each.
   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
